g.text: Current printed geometry • simplified A1M8 scanner • exploded gaps are not installed dimensions
Rear oblique view — electronics omitted for access
Four feet rest on the tall columns.
Four V1 M3×16 sets from ABOVE
clamp P12 to the frame top rails.
Feet point inward; use handed parts.

Identify the bridge before fitting the scanner
REAR: two small round P17 mounting holes.
Scanner feet: front pair 56 mm apart; rear pair 40 mm.
There is 70 mm between the two pairs.
The scanner cannot sit directly on P12.
V1: 8 screw/nut sets (4 feet + 4 bridge joints). V2: 4 tall columns + 8 screws.
V5: 2 short columns + 4 screws for P17. PCB-specific supports and fixings are still additional.
